activity_summary: The loaf was a full thumb short of the same notch, and it was still a penny. Mistress Ansell would not cut another. You ate it short.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the penny and the notch, and ate it short.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Measured a full thumb, and refused a second cut.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Told him to leave the dresser out of it.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The loaf is a full thumb short of the notch.
